steps.content: [European Sleeper] European Sleeper (ES; stylised as european sleeper) is a Belgian–Dutch cooperative operating international open-access night train services in Europe. It currently operates three night train services: one between Brussels and Prague, which launched in May 2023; another between Paris Nord and Berlin, which it launched in March 2026; and a third route launching in September 2026 between Brussels and Milan, to be combined with coaches serving Amsterdam in December 2026. | other articles: Sleeping car, 2026 in rail transport

On March 26, 2026, a new night train service operated by European Sleeper will begin, connecting Paris and Berlin. This service is part of the company's expansion into international rail transport, following the discontinuation of previous services by other operators. The Paris-Berlin route will feature three departures per week. 

FINAL: New night train service from Paris to Berlin by European Sleeper.
